packageRules.description: Label updates per ecosystem, like Dependabot did

Label updates per ecosystem, like Dependabot did

The devcontainer image moves within its 3.4-trixie line: the image definition version is updated, while Ruby and Debian stay as pinned (see the comment in the Dockerfile). MCR returns no release timestamps, so it's exempt from the minimum release age.
Leave runner labels and action version inputs alone, Dependabot never updated those

Our own actions that follow a branch (like home-assistant/actions@master) float on purpose. Pinning them would open a digest PR in every repository for each change to them. Our own actions on a version tag are pinned like any other.
Only patch releases of Ruby. The devcontainer image is pinned to the 3.4 line, so moving to a new Ruby series is a deliberate change.
